newsitem.title: USA: CME lumber futures pare profit taking losses late.
newsitem.headline: CME lumber futures pare profit taking losses late.

text.p: CME lumber futures remained under profit-taking pressure but trimmed losses late as the firmer tone to the cash market provided support, traders said.

Profit taking developed after five days of gains when reports filtered into the futures market that cash business was slowing. But futures drifted back most of the session as expectations continue to point to a firmer cash market. Cash spruce prices should be quoted higher Wednesday, they said.
Lumber closed $1.60 to $4.10 lower with November off the least at $361.90 and January off $2.00 at $369.00 per tbf.
